scope: Broad discovery catalogue for adult Punjabi households in Canada, with traditional foods, Canadian mixed routines, and occasional foods. Curated candidates, not a representative prevalence survey or a claim of exhaustive coverage.
important_notes: These are selectable food identities and artwork briefs, NOT verified nutrient records or completed image assets.

All nutrient fields are intentionally null. Resolve nutrition from the user's confirmed recipe, exact Canadian product label, current CNF record, or other properly licensed source before presenting numbers.
A bowl, katori, cup, piece or scoop is not a universal gram weight. Confirm the household serving once and save it.
Suggested quantity 1 is a UI starting point, not a recommended diet portion.
Vegetarian/other hints are discoverability aids. Ingredients, allergies, vegan status, and preparation must be confirmed; don't use these hints for allergy safety.
Do not infer religion or dietary restrictions from Punjabi identity. Optional meat/fish/egg/Canadian categories remain user-controlled.
Common variants such as fat level, sugar, roti size, tadka/oil, raw/cooked state and restaurant size are user-confirmed modifiers or separate sourced versions, not guessed calories.
Generic takeout entries need a portion/recipe or an exact brand/menu/size match. Product presence in Canada is not proof of household consumption frequency.
Keep a global read-only catalogue with per-user favourites/custom recipes. Don't insert every entry into every new user's personal journal.
Verify the current CNF version and licence; legacy online/API pages can still contain 2015 data despite the 2026 release.
Images should be created by extending the existing app's illustration system, not by scraping manufacturer photography.

Version-two food entries are unchanged. Text AI Coach is required in the first app release; scale screenshots, structured exports and health integrations are staged later. This catalogue neither implements those capabilities nor verifies imported nutrition.

categories.label: Canadian meals, takeout and gym staples

research_sources.purpose: Qualitative Canadian family research supports varied traditional and western food practices. It does not establish the prevalence of each item here.
Context on Punjabi staples and immigrant food practices; small specific population, not all households.
Current GTA availability examples for parathas, paneer, chana, saag and related foods; not an endorsed diet or a nutrient source.
Canadian/South Asian product-discovery context for dairy, snacks and sweets; exact package labels still needed.
Primary future nutrient-mapping source for Canadian foods; no nutrient values have been copied into this seed.
Current downloadable dataset reference. Verify licence and source IDs during import.
Use exact official Canadian menu/size/ingredient records for branded items; generic names here carry no brand nutrient claims.
